description: Image Description: The image depicts a display of multiple pieces of luggage on wooden shelves. The luggage is primarily black with a smooth, hard-shell design. Each piece has a price tag attached, with prices visible such as £50 and £20. Some luggage pieces have a label indicating "DOUBLE EXPANDER." The shelves are part of a store display, and there is a small sign on the right side listing different prices for various luggage options. The overall scene suggests a retail setting focused on travel gear
